objective: Refuse a physical PASS that carries no checkable measurement metadata: instrument serials, calibration validity at capture time, a numeric summary and a classified raw capture.
decision_supported: Is a matching file digest plus free-form instrument strings enough to call a physical measurement PASS?
acceptance: A physical record without instrument_serials, calibration_due or measurement_summary is refused.
Every instrument_ref needs its own serial, and serials must not repeat.
calibration_due must give a timezone-aware expiry for every serial and must not be in the past at capture time.
Every raw file must be classified, and at least one must be a capture.
The existing registration tests use a record that carries the new fields.
evidence: Before the change, a record with raw_files pointing at a file containing 'not a measurement' and instrument_refs ['whatever'] validated as a physical PASS.
After the change the same record is refused for missing calibration_due, instrument_serials and measurement_summary.
A complete record is accepted; an expired calibration, a non-numeric summary, an unclassified raw file and a record with no capture are each refused with their own message.
The two existing registration tests now use a record carrying the new fields and still pass.
stop_conditions: A real capture format cannot be classified as capture or log; that would need a third kind rather than relaxing the check.
risks_and_fallbacks: The record format grows four fields, so an old physical record no longer validates; none exists in the repository, and a fabricated one should not.
This checks that the metadata is present and coherent, not that the numbers are real; authenticity still needs the reviewer step.
